card.title: Build a Coalition
card.instruction: Recruit someone to your side so your position appears broader and more legitimate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will you join my request to keep the pottery room open late? It looks like a personal favour with one name.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your name would show it's bigger than the evening class.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The morning class wants weekend access.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Add that. Could you bring two of them? We'd be several classes asking for better access.

mechanism: A broadens a pottery access request by recruiting people and adding their needs to make it more than a personal favor.
confusable: Unlike collecting arbitrary names, A must use the recruits to establish wider legitimate interest.
comparison: D55-b includes weekend access for the morning class; D55-a includes keys for new plot holders.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
